ai_summary: Aarti Surfactants Limited reported robust financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, demonstrating substantial year-over-year growth in revenue and net profit. However, these periods were materially impacted by an undisclosed exceptional item of (430.03) Lakhs, which significantly reduced reported profit before tax. The financial statements received a clean limited review report from the auditors, while the company simultaneously announced the reconstitution of several key Board committees.
